records.title: Behaviour Is an Incomplete Measure of Reasoning Development: Cross-surface pre-arrival accessibility and the limits of developmental inference in a recurrent-depth reasoner
records.reason: This paper probes pre-arrival answer accessibility in a 30M recurrent-depth reasoner and finds measurable hidden-state signals before behavioural competence, while noting the probe population changes with the measure. It studies interpretation/evaluation rather than an inference-efficiency intervention.

records.title: StreamOPD: A Post-Training Recipe with Spatio-Temporal Cue Gating for Streaming Video Understanding
records.reason: StreamOPD post-trains streaming video models with OPD and cue gating; reported benchmark gains use an unchanged, memory-free recent-window inference protocol. It suggests quality can improve without runtime modules, but does not measure reduced inference cost relative to the same protocol.
